source.title: How I changed teaching after AI managed to do all my homework assignments
source.author: azhenley

title.zh: AI作业与教学改革：教师如何应对

excerpt.zh: AI作业让一位教师重新思考教学：当模型能完成传统作业，课堂评估应更重视过程、理解与真实能力。
excerpt.en: AI homework prompted a teacher to rethink instruction, raising questions about assessment, learning processes, and demonstrated understanding.

disclosure.zh: 本文使用星期天AI中转站大模型，基于 Hacker News 内容自动生成。
disclosure.en: This article was automatically generated by the Weekly Day AI gateway model using content from Hacker News.

text.zh: AI作业正在改变教学问题
text.en: AI Homework Changes the Teaching Question

text.zh: 这篇文章的标题提出了一个直接而重要的转折：一名教师发现，人工智能已经能够完成自己布置的全部作业，于是开始改变教学方式。这里的核心并不是某个模型的具体性能，而是传统作业作为学习证据的可靠性正在受到挑战。若学生可以轻易获得完整答案，教师就需要重新思考作业究竟要测量记忆、解题结果，还是学生对过程和概念的真实理解。
text.en: The article’s title presents a clear turning point: a teacher found that artificial intelligence could complete all of the homework assignments and consequently changed the way they taught. The central issue is not a particular model’s benchmark performance, but the reliability of traditional homework as evidence of learning. When students can readily obtain complete answers, educators may need to reconsider whether assignments should measure recall, a final result, or genuine understanding of the process and concepts.

text.zh: 从完成答案转向展示理解
text.en: From Finished Answers to Demonstrated Understanding

text.zh: 这则故事所指向的教学变化，可能包括把课堂时间和评估重点放在解释、讨论、反馈以及现场完成的任务上，也可能意味着作业需要更贴近学生的具体思考过程。这样的方向并不等于简单禁止工具使用；它更强调教师要能够判断学生是否理解答案、能否说明取舍，并能在新情境中独立应用知识。由于原文正文未提供，来源没有说明这位教师采用了哪些具体做法，因此不应把这些可能方向当作文章已报道的事实。
text.en: The change implied by the story could involve placing more emphasis on explanation, discussion, feedback, and work completed in class. It could also mean designing assignments around a student’s own reasoning process. That does not necessarily amount to banning tools. It places more weight on whether a student understands an answer, can explain the choices behind it, and can apply the knowledge in a new situation. Because the original article text is unavailable, the source does not say which specific methods this teacher adopted, so these possibilities should not be treated as reported facts.

text.zh: 最重要的开放问题是，新的评估方式能否同时保持公平、可执行和可扩展。AI作业工具降低了完成书面任务的门槛，却没有自动证明学生已经学会；反过来，要求更多口头说明或课堂观察，也会增加教师时间和资源压力。现有信息只能确认这篇文章围绕一次教学调整展开，并在Hacker News上获得125分、129条评论；它不足以判断这套方法是否有效，更不能代表所有学校或学科的结论。
text.en: The most important open question is whether new forms of assessment can remain fair, practical, and scalable. AI homework tools may lower the effort needed to produce written work, but they do not by themselves prove that a student has learned. Conversely, requiring more oral explanation or classroom observation could increase demands on teachers and institutions. The available information only confirms that the article centers on a teaching change and received 125 points and 129 comments on Hacker News. It is not enough to determine whether the approach works or to generalize across schools and subjects.
